desc:
As part of the Night Crew, your job is to contain outbreaks of paranormal entities and interdimensional anomalies. 

Join a crew, travel to affected dimensions, scrub them of anomalies, and discover the source of the disturbance. Just try not to die in the process.

🔮 Work together to collect anomalies 
🏃 Evade entities across 5 different dimensions (with more coming soon)
🌀 Discover the source of the rift and close it

🎧 Sound on

From the developer of Scary Sushi. Continues the story with new gameplay.
